title: Build an Astro project for production
description: Builds an Astro project using the `astro build` command

outputPath.description: Override the default output directory (default from astro.config)

mode.description: Build mode: 'static' for static site generation, 'server' for SSR

root.description: Project root path (usually provided by Nx)

additionalArgs.description: Additional CLI arguments to pass to Astro

generatePackageJson.description: Generate a package.json and lock file in the build output

includeDevDependencies.description: Include devDependencies in the generated package.json

includePeerDependencies.description: Include peerDependencies in the generated package.json

skipOverrides.description: Skip applying package.json overrides when generating dependencies

skipPackageManager.description: Skip generating the package manager lock file
